recommended_next_detail: The task list is complete; the project is not. Highest value action by a wide margin: run the 474 written tests against a real Odoo 18 + PostgreSQL instance with OCA auditlog and base_tier_validation on the addons path, then fix what they find. open_items: Set sec_webauthn.rp_id and sec_webauthn.origin to the permanent canonical domain BEFORE anyone enrols
Serve Odoo over HTTPS with a browser-trusted certificate; WebAuthn will not run over plain HTTP
pip install webauthn==3.0.0 on the Odoo server before installing sec_webauthn_auth
Decide phone-only vs hardware keys; the Nuclear Key holder needs two authenticators (BRD FR-6.5)
Set sec_surveillance.working_days and timezone for your working week before go-live; ships Mon-Fri which is wrong for a Sunday-Thursday week
Decide and configure high-value thresholds and their tuning owners; none ship by default, so the value control is inactive until set (PRD Section 12 open question 2)
Decide the external replication target and its independent custodian (PRD Section 12); until configured, FR-4.3 is reported as unmet
